record.bible_text: Then Eliphaz<WH0464> the Temanite<WH08489> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> and said<WH0559><WTH8799>,

Can a man<WH01397> be profitable<WH05532><WTH8799> unto God<WH0410>, as<WH03588> he that is wise<WH07919><WTH8688> may be profitable<WH05532><WTH8799> unto himself? <RF>as he...: or, if he may be profitable, doth his good success depend thereon?<Rf>

<FI> Is it<Fi> any pleasure<WH02656> to the Almighty<WH07706>, that thou art righteous<WH06663><WTH8799>? or <FI>is it<Fi> gain<WH01215> <FI>to him<Fi> , that thou makest thy ways<WH01870> perfect<WH08552><WTH8686>?
Will he reprove<WH03198><WTH8686> thee for fear<WH03374> of thee? will he enter<WH0935><WTH8799> with thee into judgment<WH04941>?<CM>
<FI> Is<Fi> not thy wickedness<WH07451> great<WH07227>? and thine iniquities<WH05771> infinite<WH07093>?

For thou hast taken a pledge<WH02254><WTH8799> from thy brother<WH0251> for nought<WH02600>, and stripped<WH06584><WTH8686> the naked<WH06174> of their clothing<WH0899>. <RF>the naked...: Heb. the clothes of the naked<Rf>
Thou hast not given water<WH04325> to the weary<WH05889> to drink<WH08248><WTH8686>, and thou hast withholden<WH04513><WTH8799> bread<WH03899> from the hungry<WH07457>.

But <FI>as for<Fi> the mighty<WH02220> man<WH0376>, he had the earth<WH0776>; and the honourable man<WH05375><WTH8803><WH06440> dwelt<WH03427><WTH8799> in it. <RF>mighty...: Heb. man of arm<Rf> <RF>honourable...: Heb. eminent, or, accepted for countenance<Rf>
Thou hast sent<WH07971><WTH8765> widows<WH0490> away empty<WH07387>, and the arms<WH02220> of the fatherless<WH03490> have been broken<WH01792><WTH8792>.
Therefore snares<WH06341> <FI>are<Fi> round about<WH05439> thee, and sudden<WH06597> fear<WH06343> troubleth<WH0926><WTH8762> thee;
Or darkness<WH02822>, <FI>that<Fi> thou canst not see<WH07200><WTH8799>; and abundance<WH08229> of waters<WH04325> cover<WH03680><WTH8762> thee.

<FI> Is<Fi> not God<WH0433> in the height<WH01363> of heaven<WH08064>? and behold<WH07200><WTH8798> the height<WH07218> of the stars<WH03556>, how high<WH07311><WTH8804> they are! <RF>height of the stars: Heb. head of the stars<Rf>
And thou sayest<WH0559><WTH8804>, How doth God<WH0410> know<WH03045><WTH8804>? can he judge<WH08199><WTH8799> through the dark cloud<WH06205>? <RF>How: or, What<Rf>
Thick clouds<WH05645> <FI>are<Fi> a covering<WH05643> to him, that he seeth<WH07200><WTH8799> not; and he walketh<WH01980><WTH8691> in the circuit<WH02329> of heaven<WH08064>.<CM>
Hast thou marked<WH08104><WTH8799> the old<WH05769> way<WH0734> which wicked<WH0205> men<WH04962> have trodden<WH01869><WTH8804>?

Which were cut down<WH07059><WTH8795> out of time<WH06256>, whose foundation<WH03247> was overflown<WH03332><WTH8714> with a flood<WH05104>: <RF>whose...: Heb. a flood was poured upon their foundation<Rf>
Which said<WH0559><WTH8802> unto God<WH0410>, Depart<WH05493><WTH8798> from us: and what can the Almighty<WH07706> do<WH06466><WTH8799> for them? <RF>for: or, to<Rf>
Yet he filled<WH04390><WTH8765> their houses<WH01004> with good<WH02896> <FI>things<Fi> : but the counsel<WH06098> of the wicked<WH07563> is far<WH07368><WTH8804> from me.
The righteous<WH06662> see<WH07200><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> , and are glad<WH08055><WTH8799>: and the innocent<WH05355> laugh them to scorn<WH03932><WTH8799>.

Whereas<WH0518> our substance<WH07009> is not cut down<WH03582><WTH8738>, but the remnant<WH03499> of them the fire<WH0784> consumeth<WH0398><WTH8804>. <RF>substance: or, estate<Rf> <RF>the remnant...: or, their excellency<Rf><CM>
Acquaint<WH05532><WTH8685> now thyself with him, and be at peace<WH07999><WTH8798>: thereby good<WH02896> shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> unto thee. <RF>him: that is, God<Rf>
Receive<WH03947><WTH8798>, I pray thee, the law<WH08451> from his mouth<WH06310>, and lay up<WH07760><WTH8798> his words<WH0561> in thine heart<WH03824>.

If thou return<WH07725><WTH8799> to the Almighty<WH07706>, thou shalt be built up<WH01129><WTH8735>, thou shalt put away<WH07368><WH00> iniquity<WH05766> far<WH07368><WTH8686> from thy tabernacles<WH0168>.
Then shalt thou lay up<WH07896><WTH8800> gold<WH01220> as<WH05921> dust<WH06083>, and the <FI>gold<Fi> of Ophir<WH0211> as the stones<WH06697> of the brooks<WH05158>. <RF>as dust: or, on the dust<Rf>
Yea, the Almighty<WH07706> shall be thy defence<WH01220>, and thou shalt have plenty<WH08443> of silver<WH03701>. <RF>defence: or, gold<Rf> <RF>plenty...: Heb. silver of strength<Rf>
For then shalt thou have thy delight<WH06026><WTH8691> in the Almighty<WH07706>, and shalt lift up<WH05375><WTH8799> thy face<WH06440> unto God<WH0433>.
Thou shalt make thy prayer<WH06279><WTH8686> unto him, and he shall hear<WH08085><WTH8799> thee, and thou shalt pay<WH07999><WTH8762> thy vows<WH05088>.
Thou shalt also decree<WH01504><WTH8799> a thing<WH0562>, and it shall be established<WH06965><WTH8799> unto thee: and the light<WH0216> shall shine<WH05050><WTH8804> upon thy ways<WH01870>.

When <FI>men<Fi> are cast down<WH08213><WTH8689>, then thou shalt say<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>There is<Fi> lifting up<WH01466>; and he shall save<WH03467><WTH8686> the humble<WH07807> person<WH05869>. <RF>the humble...: Heb. him that hath low eyes<Rf>

He shall deliver<WH04422><WTH8762> the island<WH0336> of the innocent<WH05355>: and it is delivered<WH04422><WTH8738> by the pureness<WH01252> of thine hands<WH03709>. <RF>He shall...: or, The innocent shall deliver the island<Rf><CM>
